name: The Beach Boys

whyMatters.en: California group formed in 1961. From surf singles they gradually joined vocal harmony, instrumental arrangement, and studio production. Pet Sounds and Good Vibrations (1966) mark that shift at a mature stage.
whyMatters.zh: 加州组合，1961 年成立。从冲浪单曲开始，逐渐把人声和声、器乐编曲与录音室制作结合起来。1966 年的《Pet Sounds》和《Good Vibrations》标志着这一转变进入成熟阶段。

note.en: Early Capitol surf single; Chuck Berry–derived guitar figure.
note.zh: 早期 Capitol 冲浪单曲；源自 Chuck Berry 的吉他音型。

note.en: First US #1 and first million-seller; UK top 10.
note.zh: 首支美国冠军与首支销量过百万单曲；英国榜前 10。

note.en: US #1 single in the mid-60s chart run.
note.zh: 60 年代中期美国榜冠军单曲。

note.en: Pet Sounds; layered vocals and French horn.
note.zh: 出自 Pet Sounds；多层人声与法国号。

note.en: Multi-studio sectional single; electro-theremin hook; UK #1.
note.zh: 多录音室分段单曲；electro-theremin hook；英国榜冠军。

note.en: Holland lead single; Blondie Chaplin on lead vocal.
Cocktail soundtrack; first US #1 in 22 years.
note.zh: 电影《鸡尾酒》配乐；时隔 22 年再登美国榜冠军。

shortBio.en: California group formed in 1961. Early singles built recognition around surf, cars, and youth themes; the focus later shifted toward studio work. Brian Wilson’s Pet Sounds (1966) and Good Vibrations are the main records of that stage.
shortBio.zh: 加州组合，1961 年成立。早期以冲浪、汽车和青春题材单曲建立知名度，随后逐渐把重心转向录音室制作。Brian Wilson 主导的《Pet Sounds》（1966）和《Good Vibrations》是这一阶段的代表作品。

body.en: California group formed in 1961. Early singles built recognition around surf, cars, and youth themes; the focus later shifted toward studio work. Brian Wilson’s Pet Sounds (1966) and Good Vibrations are the main records of that stage.
body.zh: 加州组合，1961 年成立。早期以冲浪、汽车和青春题材单曲建立知名度，随后逐渐把重心转向录音室制作。Brian Wilson 主导的《Pet Sounds》（1966）和《Good Vibrations》是这一阶段的代表作品。

note.en: 1963 Capitol single. Early surf theme with a Chuck Berry–styled guitar figure and stacked vocals.
note.zh: 1963 年 Capitol 单曲。早期冲浪主题，Chuck Berry 风格的吉他进行与多层人声和声。

note.en: 1964: first US #1 and first million-seller; UK top 10. Same period as an Ed Sullivan appearance.
note.zh: 1964 年：首支美国冠军与首支销量过百万单曲，英国榜前十。同期登上 Ed Sullivan。

note.en: From Pet Sounds. Layered vocals and French horn. Pet Sounds answered Beatles’ Rubber Soul; George Martin later tied Beach Boys studio methods to Sgt. Pepper.
note.zh: 出自 Pet Sounds。多层人声与法国号。Pet Sounds 回应 Beatles《Rubber Soul》；George Martin 后来把 Beach Boys 录音室做法与《Sgt. Pepper》联系起来。

note.en: Capitol single. Sections recorded separately across studios and edited together; electro-theremin is a main melodic element. Reached UK #1.
note.zh: Capitol 单曲。歌曲由多个录音室片段分别录制后剪辑组合，并以 electro-theremin 音色作为重要的旋律元素；发行后登上英国榜冠军。

body.en:
Pet Sounds (1966) changed the Beach Boys’ early focus on surf songs.

Wouldn’t It Be Nice, God Only Knows and related cuts use denser vocal and instrumental arranging; some tracking used Los Angeles session players. Brian Wilson also handled much of the production.

Good Vibrations assembled sections recorded in different studios and edited them together. Cello, vocals, and electro-theremin sit in the same sound stack.
body.zh:
《Pet Sounds》（1966）改变了 Beach Boys 早期以冲浪歌曲为主的创作方向。

《Wouldn’t It Be Nice》《God Only Knows》等作品使用了更密集的人声和器乐编曲，部分录音由洛杉矶 session 乐手完成。Brian Wilson 同时负责大量制作工作。

《Good Vibrations》则把不同录音室录制的片段剪辑组合起来，大提琴、人声和 electro-theremin 共同构成歌曲的声音层次。

alt.en: The Beach Boys Capitol publicity photo, circa 1964
alt.zh: The Beach Boys Capitol 宣传照，约 1964 年

body.en:
The early core included Brian, Carl, and Dennis Wilson, Mike Love, and Al Jardine. During Jardine’s brief absence, David Marks played guitar.

After 1964 Brian Wilson no longer toured regularly; Glen Campbell and then Bruce Johnston covered the stage seat.

In the early 1970s Blondie Chaplin and Ricky Fataar joined. Chaplin sang lead on Sail On, Sailor from Holland. After leaving, Bruce Johnston returned in 1978.
body.zh:
早期核心成员包括 Brian、Carl、Dennis Wilson、Mike Love 和 Al Jardine。Jardine 短暂离队期间，David Marks 负责吉他。

1964 年后 Brian Wilson 不再长期参加巡演，先后由 Glen Campbell 和 Bruce Johnston 顶替现场位置。

1970 年代初，Blondie Chaplin 和 Ricky Fataar 加入乐队。Chaplin 在《Holland》中的《Sail On, Sailor》担任主唱。Bruce Johnston 离队后，于 1978 年回归。

alt.en: The Beach Boys in Billboard magazine, December 1964
alt.zh: The Beach Boys 出现在 1964 年 12 月 Billboard

title.zh: 与 The Beatles 的交叉聆听

body.en:
Pet Sounds is usually discussed after Rubber Soul. Both albums mark a mid-1960s move from single-led pop toward studio-led writing.

George Martin later linked Beach Boys production methods with the making of Sgt. Pepper. In Rishikesh in 1968, a photo of Mike Love with Beatles members also records the contact between the two acts.

Both used Capitol for US releases. The relationship included competition as well as mutual listening and exchange.
body.zh:
《Pet Sounds》通常被放在《Rubber Soul》之后讨论。两张专辑都代表了 1960 年代中期流行音乐从单曲导向录音室创作的变化。

George Martin 后来谈到 Beach Boys 的制作方法时，将其与《Sgt. Pepper》的录音联系起来。1968 年在瑞诗凯诗，Mike Love 与 Beatles 成员同框的照片也记录了两支乐队之间的交集。

两队在美国都由 Capitol 发行过作品。它们之间的关系既有竞争，也有相互影响和交流。

title.en: I Get Around and Ed Sullivan

body.en:
I Get Around (1964) was the Beach Boys’ first US #1 single, their first million-seller, and a UK top-10 hit.

The band also appeared on the Ed Sullivan Show in that period. Help Me, Rhonda later reached US #1 as well.

In 1964 Brian Wilson began cutting back on touring to spend more time in the studio, preparing the work that led to Pet Sounds.
body.zh:
《I Get Around》（1964）是 Beach Boys 第一首美国冠军单曲，也是第一首销量超过百万的单曲，并进入英国榜前十。

乐队同期登上 Ed Sullivan Show。《Help Me, Rhonda》后来也登上美国榜冠军。

1964 年，Brian Wilson 开始减少巡演，把更多时间投入录音室，为之后的《Pet Sounds》做准备。

alt.en: The Beach Boys on The Ed Sullivan Show performing I Get Around, 1964
alt.zh: The Beach Boys 在 Ed Sullivan Show 演唱 I Get Around，1964

body.en:
Surfin’ U.S.A. was issued by Capitol in 1963.

It continues the early Beach Boys surf theme, with a Chuck Berry–styled guitar figure and stacked vocal harmony as the main sound marks.
body.zh:
《Surfin' U.S.A.》于 1963 年由 Capitol 发行。

歌曲延续 Beach Boys 早期的冲浪主题，以 Chuck Berry 风格的吉他进行和多层人声和声为主要声音特征。

body.en:
Good Vibrations was released in 1966.

It was not cut in one pass: sections from different studios were finished separately, then edited into the final version. The electro-theremin is one of the easiest sounds to recognize.
body.zh:
《Good Vibrations》于 1966 年发行。

歌曲并非一次完成，而是把不同录音室的录音片段分别制作，再剪辑成最终版本。electro-theremin 是其中最容易辨认的声音之一。

body.en:
Surf’s Up (1971) and Holland (1973) kept widening Beach Boys writing, including environmental and political subjects.

The lineup by then differed clearly from the 1960s. Blondie Chaplin and Ricky Fataar joined; Brian Wilson largely stopped touring; Bruce Johnston returned in 1978.

In 1979 Bruce Johnston and three other singers took part in related sessions for Pink Floyd’s The Wall; the Beach Boys as a full band did not. Dennis Wilson died in 1983; Carl Wilson in 1998. Kokomo returned them to US #1 in 1988.
body.zh:
《Surf’s Up》（1971）和《Holland》（1973）继续扩展 Beach Boys 的创作范围，其中出现了环境和政治题材。

这一时期的阵容与 1960 年代已有明显不同。Blondie Chaplin 和 Ricky Fataar 加入，Brian Wilson 基本不再巡演，Bruce Johnston 则在 1978 年回归。

1979 年，Bruce Johnston 与另外三位歌手参与 Pink Floyd《The Wall》的相关录音；Beach Boys 整队没有参与。Dennis Wilson 于 1983 年去世，Carl Wilson 于 1998 年去世。《Kokomo》在 1988 年重新登上美国榜冠军。

interviewQuotes.text: I wanted to write a teenage symphony to God.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Brian Wilson

interviewQuotes.text: Good Vibrations was modular. We built it in pieces.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Brian Wilson

label.zh: 早期 Capitol / Marks 时期

note.en: Jardine briefly out; Marks on guitar for early Capitol singles.
note.zh: Jardine 短暂离队；早期 Capitol 单曲由 Marks 任吉他。

label.zh: Pet Sounds / Smile Brian 主导

note.en: Brian-led studio years around Pet Sounds, Good Vibrations, and Smile. Johnston had replaced Campbell on the road.
note.zh: Brian 主导的录音室时期：Pet Sounds、Good Vibrations 与 Smile。Johnston 已接替 Campbell 的巡演位置。

note.en: Chaplin sang Sail On, Sailor. Brian was largely off the road; Johnston had left before returning in 1978.
note.zh: Chaplin 主唱 Sail On, Sailor。Brian 基本不巡演；Johnston 已离队，1978 年才回归。

note.en: Capitol single. Sections recorded separately across studios and edited together; electro-theremin is a main melodic element. Reached #1 in the UK.
note.zh: Capitol 单曲。歌曲由多个录音室片段分别录制后剪辑组合，并以 electro-theremin 音色作为重要的旋律元素；发行后登上英国榜冠军。

note.en: Joined California harmony, vocal arranging, and denser studio production; influenced mid-1960s pop and rock recording.
note.zh: 把加州和声、人声编曲与更复杂的录音室制作结合起来，对 1960 年代中期的流行和摇滚录音产生了影响。
